_about: Logic checks on the values read from Form 1A, run while the user edits and again when saving.
Change the numbers here and restart the reader (python run.py). Nothing is hard-coded in the program.
enabled: false switches a check off.
severity: "error" = must be corrected before the enrolment can be saved;
"warning" = shown to the user, but saving is still allowed.

applicant_birth_year._item: Section A, item 5: year of birth

employer_name_when_employed._item: Section A, items 10 and 11: if 'employed' is ticked, the employer's name must be filled in

primary_school_completion_year._item: Section A, item 14: year primary school was completed, compared with the year of birth

middle_name_is_father_first_name._item: Section A item 2 (middle name) must be the same as section B item 15 (father's first name). Switched off: many people's middle name is not their father's first name

father_birth_year._item: Section B, item 19: father's year of birth; the father must be at least this many years older than the applicant

mother_birth_year._item: Section B, item 24: mother's year of birth; the mother must be at least this many years older than the applicant

names_from_official_list._item: Region, district and ward fields: the value must be a name from the official list, and the district must be in the chosen region, the ward in the chosen district (app/lookup_settings.json)
